agentPromptId.description: The ID of the agent prompt used in the dynamic agent.

uiContextMap.description:
A map from a targetPageName of a route in the application to a context string which will be passed to the agent prompt when the user uses the side panel from that page.
 The context string will be passed to agent prompt and will be set in the 'UI_CONTEXT' parameter of the prompt.
 Example: {
"AlertDetailConditionalRender": "User is on the alert detail page viewing content for the alert with id"
}
 Make sure to use the 'pageParamName' in the context string so that it can be replaced with the actual values stored in the page params in the application state by regex matching.
 In the example above, the 'id' is the page param name for the alert detail page route. These names can be inferred from the route csv file.

agentConfigName.description: The name of the agent that the user can interact with on the side panel within the application.
